text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph breaks and transition words like \"In half way\" and \"Between teacher's designed and student's designed\"","quality":"organization","description":"The writing is grouped into distinct points and uses transitions to move through the argument more coherently."},{"evidence":"repeated argument structure with reasons and examples about summer projects","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay supports its main claim with multiple connected reasons and illustrative examples."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"if student can decide they own project title\" and \"they can create title base on animals,vehicles,or their life experience\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The response expands ideas with more specific details rather than staying at the level of personal complaint or repetition."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"teacher can not make suitable choices for students\" and \"it will be a lot interesting and easy\"","quality":"lexical variety","description":"The essay shows a somewhat wider range of content words and topic vocabulary for expressing its points."},{"evidence":"attempts at more complex sentence forms with clauses introduced by \"if\" and \"because\"","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"The writing uses more varied sentence structures, including conditional and causal constructions."}]}
